_comment: A collection, not a program: fluxmethods publishes the estimators of this
package as plain functions, with no pipeline, no configuration and nothing
to invoke. So there is no `runtime` and no dialect here -- there is no
config of its own to read and no binary to run -- and the rows below carry
no `selector`, because a collection has no settings to select a method by.
What the `collection` kind changes is what a twin MEANS (core/bridge.py,
and docs/meta/flux_library_protocol.md): the method now lives there, so the
twin supersedes the transcription rather than standing beside it as a
comparison -- and only where the checkout is actually present, since
registration needs none. The source is not a dependency: without it these
register, report unavailable, and every transcription goes on running here.

clone: or, outside a checkout of this repository: git clone https://github.com/pedrohenriquecoimbra/fluxmethods.git, then set FLUXMETHODS_SRC to its fluxmethods/ directory

correction:resampling.name: linear
correction:resampling.description: linear interpolation of each variable onto the target timestamps

run.description: calls the collection's copy of this estimator in place of the transcription

correction:resampling.no_scientific_reference: a copy of this package's own estimator, published by fluxmethods as resampling:linear
